name: Fujimori Shin
source:
15 years old.

A self-proclaimed dweeb who loiters about Asakusa. He's always caught up in a different fight with each encounter, and develops a friendly relationship with Goemon and the others after being saved by them. A closeted fan of [url=https://vndb.org/c106446]Azamin[/url]'s.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/shin/]Aksys Games[/url]]
